title: The Nan map: the Thailand map's look
kaylee: The Nan map now floats in the sky like the Thailand map: the same tray and clouds, the same camera swoop in, and a cake-slice Nan with toy mountains, trees and places.
questions: On a tall screen (iPad held upright, a phone) the board still turns so its long side runs up the screen. Keep that, or show it wide like it is sideways?
